segments.speaker: Lala Bhai
segments.text: [frustrated] Bhai, enquiries toh bahut aa rahi hain... [pause] lekin confirmed home service bookings? [disappointed] Woh toh jaise gayab hi ho gayi hain!

segments.speaker: Sid
segments.text: [playful] Arre Lala Bhai! Phone toh garam ho raha hai... [teasing] par business thanda kyun pada hai?

segments.speaker: Lala Bhai
segments.text: [annoyed] Kya bataun, Bhai! Koi sirf price poochta hai, koi service area ke bahar hota hai... aur koi bolta hai, "Baad mein batata hoon."

segments.speaker: Sid
segments.text: [confident] Toh problem enquiries ki quantity nahi hai, Lala Bhai... [emphasis] problem hai unki quality!

segments.speaker: Sid
segments.text: [explaining] Matlab, har enquiry actual customer nahi hoti. Tumhe aise log chahiye jinhe sach mein repair service ki zaroorat ho.

segments.speaker: Sid
segments.text: [upbeat] Aur yahin FixReach karta hai help! [confident] Better-qualified customer enquiries aur home-service booking opportunities paane mein.

segments.speaker: Sid
segments.text: [clear, deliberate] Customer se samjho teen simple cheezein:

segments.speaker: Sid
segments.text: [slight pause] Pehli — problem kya hai? [slight pause] Doosri — location kahan hai? [slight pause] Teesri — service kab chahiye?

segments.speaker: Sid
segments.text: [reassuring] Isse tum customer ki requirement samajh sakte ho aur home service visit schedule karne mein better planning kar sakte ho.

segments.speaker: Lala Bhai
segments.text: [realization] Achhaaa! Matlab ab sirf phone calls ke peeche nahi bhaagna... [excited] balki actual service chahne wale customers par focus karna hai!

segments.speaker: Sid
segments.text: [affirming] Bilkul! Technician ko bhi pata hoga ki kis customer ke ghar jaana hai.

segments.speaker: Sid
segments.text: [energetic, direct] Aap bhi repair business chalate ho? Aur better leads chahte ho?

segments.speaker: Sid
segments.text: [enthusiastic] FixReach ki taraf se milega aapko FREE Campaign Audit!

segments.speaker: Sid
segments.text: [cheerful] Bilkul free, Bhai! Apni campaigns ka haal jaan lo!
